_README: Input for scripts/generate-invoice.js — fill this in and run:
ALL AMOUNTS ARE INTEGER MINOR UNITS (paise for INR, cents for USD).
Never write a decimal amount here.
Tax is computed by the same engine the app uses:
seller.gstin absent            → no tax charged, recorded as 'no_registration'
seller state == buyer state    → CGST 9% + SGST 9%
buyer outside India            → zero-rated export (set defaults.export_under_lut
to false if you do NOT hold an LUT)
Buyer state is taken from the buyer's GSTIN when present, otherwise region_code.
State codes are the two-letter GST codes: MH, KA, DL, TN, ...
invoice_number: supply your own. This script does NOT touch the live
sequence, so pick numbers that do not collide with anything the app has
issued. Format used by the app is SERIES/FY/NNNNNN, e.g. RB/2026-27/000001.
